title: Daemonless OCI Image Construction for Secure CI/CD
business: Organizations managing high-security build pipelines that require OCI-compliant images without exposing a persistent container daemon.
problem: Traditional container build environments often require a long-running daemon with elevated privileges, creating a significant security surface area and complicating integration into hardened Kubernetes clusters.
solution: Buildah enables the creation of OCI container images using scripts or Containerfiles without needing a full container runtime or daemon installed, allowing for lightweight, rootless, and secure image generation.
steps: Initialize a working container instance from a base image using buildah from.
Execute commands within the container context to install dependencies or copy application artifacts.
Commit the modified container state to a new OCI image using buildah commit.
Push the resulting image to a registry for deployment.
outcome: A streamlined, daemonless build process that integrates directly into existing CI/CD pipelines while reducing the security risks associated with privileged daemon access.
limitation: Buildah lacks a persistent daemon, meaning it does not manage container lifecycles or runtime execution; users must verify image integrity and runtime compatibility using external tools like Skopeo or Podman.
